Our channel features canine and feline echocardiography tutorials for veterinarians, focusing on probe positioning, view recognition and image interpretation. 

You can sign up to the VE newsletter here: https://www.animalultrasoundassociation.org/for-vets

You can find out more about our training and mentorship programme here: https://calendly.com/veterinaryechocardiography/30min
